architecture.western_conditions: Biomedical diagnoses and clinical problems, stored separately from TCM categories.
architecture.eastern_diseases: Traditional disease names such as infertility, amenorrhea, dysmenorrhea, delayed menstruation.
architecture.tcm_patterns: Pattern differentiation layer such as Kidney deficiency, Liver qi stagnation, Phlegm-damp obstruction, Blood stasis.
architecture.western_medications: English-first medication and drug class layer for future herb-drug and acupuncture safety checks.
architecture.relation_tables: Overlap is handled through explicit links, not by merging Western and Eastern concepts into one table.
